CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2697 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4aad9c1175318dec0b90da4113259c3ddb38309f. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 4aad9c1175318dec0b90da4113259c3ddb38309f for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r9, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-merge-subject-harden-r9 <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r9; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from PR #2697 head 4aad9c1175318dec0b90da4113259c3ddb38309f (branch fix/r10-merge-subject-harden; handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8 tip 43940f751710310f4b32f0171b87b8fac153458a, body ref handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r8). Do not restart from main; merge origin/main first. Round 9 after round 8 was blocked class-open (read git show origin/review/2697:VERDICT.md and origin/verdict/2697, including evidence/ with the finder's plants md_plant.sh, own_probes2.txt, own_probes3.txt, probe.mjs, lead_closer_count.py).
The block: the head REGRESSES main. A line whose lead holds a closer with no opener on the line is refused at origin/main (880b667aa) and not at the head. Reviewer's case: a wrapped Markdown parenthetical closing on the merge line, `down) with gh pr merge 9 --subject x`, refused=1 at main and refused=0 at the head under `python3 -I tools/policy/agreement_py.py --run` with the plant of evidence/md_plant.sh appended to .claude/workflows/web-fragments.md (head: 64 merge calls, refused=0; main: 54 calls, refused=1 at web-fragments.md:157). Same class: Markdown `1)` and `a)` list items, `- step 2) ...`, `:)`, and a shell array closed on the merge line (`); gh pr merge 9 --subject x`). The owner's ruling under the mandate: a minimal split PR may not regress main, so this cannot be carried; it comes back to you.
HARD ACCEPTANCE (all three, in the body with their commands):
(1) A differential, not a list: over the finder's harness corpus plus the reviewer's cases (every plant in the verdict's evidence dir and your own generated lines for the closer-in-lead class), show that every line refused at origin/main is still refused at the head (refused-at-main is a subset of refused-at-head). Print the set sizes and the failure count of the differential side by side, e.g. `lines=N refused_main=A refused_head=B main_not_head=0`; the null control is the same differential run at 4aad9c11, which must print main_not_head greater than 0 (the reviewer's line at least).
(2) Pin the reviewer's line as a test that FAILS at 4aad9c11 and passes at your head (failing test first; show both).
(3) Do not narrow further by dropping a guard: no guard main has is removed or loosened. The root fix round 7 named is the way: start the forward read at the lead's start, or skip a closer the backward read already found unmatched, so a closer in the lead without an opener no longer ends the extent before `pr`. Anything that main also accepts (a line main does NOT refuse) stays in R10-MERGE-SUBJECT-CASEARM, with its expected-fail marker; state in the body that the group's brief must record the regression-against-main control as main's own refused=1 at the stage's merge base, and the three routed spellings (a blank line in a Python or JS argv, and a `)` in a JS /* */ after merge). Add the `*)` default arm and a glob arm (`[0-9]*)`) to the case-arm expected-fail enumeration.
Also: structure.py exits 0 at the final head (re-record DOWN with the reason, never a raise); re-take every figure at the final head with its command; put ledger keys in plain text, not a code span, and run `node tools/policy/figure_lint.mjs --pr-body <body> --at origin/handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r9` after pushing the handoff ref (0 REFUSED); prepr --body-check to green. This is the ninth round: re-cut the body minimal. Push exactly two refs: handoff/r10-merge-subject-harden-r9 and handoff-body/r10-merge-subject-harden-r9.
